title: 第七百八十八章 蝶影传书 夜剑问心第七百八十七章 昭冤雪谤 义动天听
content_zh:
朱祁镇话音刚落，身侧的杨士奇当即躬身垂首，仪态端方，郑重出列禀奏道：“太子殿下，邰武府乃是臣昔日管辖旧地。此地民情吏治，臣最为熟悉知晓。此案繁杂，牵扯旧年宦党余孽，便交由臣全权查办梳理。定不负殿下所托！”
朱祁镇微微颔首，目光锐利肃穆。
字字铿锵，厉声叮嘱道：“甚好！此事交由你全权负责，务必彻查到底、细细核实！一旦查证属实，所有牵涉此案、徇私枉法、附势作恶的官员。一概严惩不贷、绝不姑息！绝不能让奸佞乱我朝纲、污我大明清正名声、寒了天下忠臣义士之心！”
这番话，既是嘱托杨士奇秉公办案，更是特意说与虫小蝶、沈惊鸿等一众江湖义士听闻。
意在昭示自己赏善罚恶、守正不阿、公私分明的储君本心。
坦荡磊落、绝不徇私！
虫小蝶见状，心中大石微落。
当即躬身长揖，郑重谢恩道：“草民代蓝家满门，多谢太子殿下圣明！”
殿中肃穆稍缓之际，一旁静立的沈惊鸿上前一步。
身姿沉稳，敛衽躬身，态度恭谨谦和，朗声开口道：“太子殿下，草民亦有一不情之请，斗胆恳请殿下成全！”
朱祁镇压下心中余怒，神色稍缓。
大袖从容一挥，气度宽宏，朗声笑道：“沈大侠但讲无妨！但凡所求，朕一概应允！”
沈惊鸿垂眸正色，语气诚恳坦荡道：“此番涟王作乱、祸乱宫闱，我古剑盟弟子顾雁枫心性不坚，受逆党奸言蛊惑、迷途深陷。一时糊涂附逆作乱，犯下谋逆大罪，实属咎由自取、自掘坟墓。我盟上下绝不包庇半分，任凭朝廷处置！”
他抬眸直视朱祁镇，字字恳切，句句为公道：“只是顾雁枫一己之过，与旁人无干！我古剑盟其余所有弟子门人，皆恪守正道、忠心向国。全程未曾参与半点叛乱逆事！草民斗胆恳请殿下明察秋毫，切勿迁怒宗门、株连无辜！”
朱祁镇听完，顿时朗声长笑！
笑声坦荡洪亮，回荡在整座奉天大殿。
消解了殿中残存的沉郁肃杀之气！
他目光温和舒缓，看着眼前恳切陈情的沈惊鸿。
神色宽和大气，尽显储君胸襟道：“沈大侠未免太小看朕了！朕身居储位，执掌社稷权衡。素来深知律法公道、罪不及众的道理！”
“顾雁枫一人附逆作乱，是他个人心性败坏、背弃正道。罪责全在其身！与古剑盟满门上下毫无干系，朕岂会不分黑白、迁罚无辜？”

他微微抬手，语气愈发温厚开明。
带着赞许之意道：“更何况此番宫变危急、社稷动荡。古剑盟诸多弟子随诸位大侠奔赴宫闱、奋力平叛。浴血厮杀、出力甚多。为平定叛乱、稳固大明江山立下大功。乃是有功于朝廷、有功于社稷的正道宗门！”
“朕非但不会追责迁怒、为难古剑盟分毫。往后还会认可你宗门忠义之名，默许古剑盟立足江湖、匡扶正道！但凡宗门恪守忠义、安分守礼，朝廷便会为尔等撑腰庇护，绝不妄加苛责！”
沈惊鸿闻言心中大安，紧绷的神色彻底舒展。
当即躬身深深一揖，礼数周全、满心感激道：“草民代古剑盟上下门人，谢太子殿下圣明宽仁！”
待二人诉求尽数了结，朱祁镇目光扫过殿中一众平叛有功将士。
神色转为肃穆嘉奖。
content_en:
As soon as Zhu Qizhen finished speaking, Yang Shiqi beside him immediately bowed his head, with a dignified manner, and solemnly went out to report: "Your Highness, Taiwu Mansion is the old place under my jurisdiction in the past. I am most familiar with the people's customs and the governance of this place. This case is complicated and involves the remnants of the eunuchs of the past, so I will give it to you to investigate and sort it out. I will definitely live up to your highness's trust!"
Zhu Qizhen nodded slightly, his eyes sharp and solemn.
The words were sonorous, and he warned sternly: "Very good! You have full responsibility for this matter, and you must investigate it thoroughly and verify it carefully! Once it is verified that it is true, all officials involved in this case, bending the law for personal gain, and doing evil with the power of others will be severely punished and will not be tolerated! We must not allow traitors to mess up our court, taint our reputation for Ming Dynasty, and chill the hearts of loyal ministers and righteous people in the world!"
These words were not only entrusted to Yang Shiqi to handle the case impartially, but also specifically meant to be heard by Chong Xiaodie, Shen Jinghong and other righteous men in the world.
It is intended to show the prince's true intention of rewarding good and punishing evil, upholding integrity, and distinguishing between public and private affairs.
Be upright and aboveboard, never show favoritism!
When Chong Xiaodie saw this, her heart dropped slightly.
He immediately bowed and bowed, and solemnly thanked him: "The Lan family is full of grass-roots people. Thank you very much, His Royal Highness the Crown Prince!"
When the solemnity in the hall eased, Shen Jinghong, who was standing silently on the side, took a step forward.
With a calm posture, he bowed with his crotch folded, his attitude was respectful and modest, and he said loudly: "Your Highness, the common people also have a heartless request, and I boldly ask Your Highness to grant it!"
Zhu Qi suppressed the remaining anger in his heart and his expression softened slightly.
He waved his sleeves calmly, with a magnanimous manner, and laughed loudly: "It's okay, Master Shen! Whatever you ask for, I will grant you!"
Shen Jinghong lowered his eyes seriously and said in a sincere and frank tone: "This time King Lian caused chaos and brought trouble to the palace, Gu Yanfeng, a disciple of the Ancient Sword Alliance, has a weak heart. He was seduced by the traitor's treacherous words and went astray. He was confused and rebelled for a moment and committed the crime of treason. He really brought the blame on himself and dug his own grave. Our alliance will not cover up the slightest, and let the court handle it!"
He raised his eyes and looked directly at Zhu Qizhen, saying sincerely and honestly: "It's just Gu Yanfeng's fault, and it has nothing to do with anyone else! All the other disciples of our Ancient Sword Alliance abide by the right path and are loyal to the country. They have not participated in any rebellion or rebellion in the whole process! The common people boldly ask Your Highness to understand the truth and never anger the sect or implicate innocent people!"
After Zhu Qizhen heard this, he laughed loudly!
The laughter was magnanimous and loud, echoing throughout the Fengtian Hall.
It dispelled the remaining gloomy and solemn atmosphere in the palace!
His eyes were gentle and soothing, looking at Shen Jinghong who was earnestly expressing his love in front of him.
His expression was broad and majestic, showing the prince's magnanimity and he said: "Master Shen, you have underestimated me! I am in the reserve position, in charge of the balance of the country and the country. I have always understood the principle that the law is just and the crime is not punished by others!"
"Gu Yanfeng rebelled and caused chaos by himself. It is because of his corrupt character and his betrayal of the right path. The entire blame lies with him! He has nothing to do with the whole family of the Ancient Sword Alliance. How can I punish innocent people without distinguishing between right and wrong?"
He raised his hand slightly, his tone becoming more gentle and open-minded.
He said with approval: "What's more, this time the palace is in crisis and the country is in turmoil. Many disciples of the Ancient Sword Alliance rushed to the palace with the heroes and worked hard to quell the rebellion. They fought bloody and made great contributions. They made great contributions to quelling the rebellion and stabilizing the Ming Dynasty. They are a righteous sect that has contributed to the court and the country!"
"Not only will I not pursue blame, anger, or embarrass the Ancient Sword Alliance in the slightest, but I will also recognize your sect's name of loyalty in the future and acquiesce in allowing the Ancient Sword Alliance to establish a foothold in the world and uphold the right path! As long as the sect abides by loyalty and integrity, and observes etiquette, the imperial court will support and protect you, and will never impose harsh punishments!"
Shen Jinghong felt relieved after hearing this, and his tense expression completely relaxed.
Immediately he bowed deeply and said with all the courtesy and gratitude: "From the disciples of the Cao Min Dynasty Ancient Sword Alliance, I would like to express my gratitude to His Royal Highness the Crown Prince for his sage and generosity!"
After the two men's demands were settled, Zhu Qizhen glanced at the soldiers in the palace who had served in countering the rebellion.
His expression turned to solemn and commendable.
